topic: What constraints do the lenses' loss profiles (4.2 dB) impose on power amplification and thermal budgets for payload efficiency?
consensus_response: The lenses' loss profiles impose a constraint of 4.2 dB on power amplification and thermal budgets, compromising system reliability and capacity. High dissipation losses within the lens itself (2.2 dB) and internal reflection losses at interfaces (2 dB) contribute to this limitation. Using lower-loss materials and matching layers can reduce losses from 4.2 dB to approximately 1 dB, but this may require compromises in other system parameters.
